# Preparing the data 

```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# CENSUS DATA 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Data by individual 
Personas_Censo_1992 <- read_sav("C:/Users/mlzam/OneDrive/Documents/repos/chile1988/data/PERSONA.sav",
 col_select = c(Comuna_1987_Origen3, Tipo_educacion, Curso, Rama_actividad,
  Ocupacion))

# Only observations from Chileans who lived in Chile in 1987
Chilenos_Censo_1987 <-Personas_Censo_1992 %>%
  filter(Comuna_1987_Origen3 >= 1101 & Comuna_1987_Origen3 <= 13605, 
         Comuna_1987_Origen3 %% 100 != 0)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA FROM THE PAPER REPLICATION 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Voting data by municipality
VotingData_Dataverse <- read_dta("C:/Users/mlzam/OneDrive/Documents/repos/chile1988/data/FinalDatasetForReplication.dta",
col_select = c(comuna, IDProv, VoteShareNo, shvictimas_until74_70, 
shvictimas_75_plus_70, lnDistRegCapital, share_allende70, DMilitaryPresence, 
longitud, latitud, sh_rural_70, share_aylwin89, sh_educ_12more))

# Read shapefile for geometry 
Comunas_Dataverse <- st_read("C:/Users/mlzam/OneDrive/Documents/Files/MIT/spring 26/quant 2/chile1988/dataverse_files (3)/Paper Replication/Data/Map/cl_comunas_geo/Paper Replication/Data/Map/cl_comunas_geo.shp",
query = "SELECT ID_2002, NOMBRE FROM cl_comunas_geo")

# Municipality codes from 1992 census 
Comunas_Censo_1992 <- read_sav("C:/Users/mlzam/OneDrive/Documents/repos/chile1988/data/COMUNAS.sav",
  col_select = c(Codigo, Nombre))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Prepping the data 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# First, find each municipality's numerical ID and attach it to the 
# municipality voting data 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The municipalities file comes in polygon shape
# Do some conversions to match both databases 

# Convert Dataverse voting data to spatial object using lat/lon columns
Dataverse_temp <- VotingData_Dataverse |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitud", "latitud"), crs = 4326)

# Use flat geometry instead of spherical to avoid errors
sf_use_s2(FALSE)

# Fix any invalid polygon geometries in the shapefile before joining
Comunas_Dataverse <- st_make_valid(Comunas_Dataverse)

# Spatial join: for each voting data point, find which municipality polygon 
# it falls inside and attach that comuna's ID_2002 and name
crosswalk <- st_join(Dataverse_temp, Comunas_Dataverse |>
  select(ID_2002, NOMBRE)) |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>    # Drop geometry, no longer needed
  select(comuna, ID_2002, NOMBRE)  # Keep only the three columns I need

# Fix NAs manually, then drop unresolvable ones
crosswalk <- crosswalk |>
  mutate(
    ID_2002 = case_when(
      comuna == 53  ~ "1101",  # Iquique
      comuna == 54  ~ "10209", # Quemchi
      comuna == 93  ~ "10101", # Puerto Montt
      comuna == 147 ~ "13403", # Calera de Tango
      comuna == 175 ~ "2102",  # Mejillones
      comuna == 184 ~ "11202", # Cisnes
      comuna == 298 ~ "10210", # Quinchao
      comuna == 87 ~ "5104",  # Juan Fernández
      TRUE ~ ID_2002
    ),
    NOMBRE = case_when(
      comuna == 53  ~ "Iquique",
      comuna == 54  ~ "Quemchi",
      comuna == 93  ~ "Puerto Montt",
      comuna == 147 ~ "Calera de Tango",
      comuna == 175 ~ "Mejillones",
      comuna == 184 ~ "Cisnes",
      comuna == 298 ~ "Quinchao",
      comuna == 87 ~ "Juan Fernández", 
      TRUE ~ NOMBRE
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(ID_2002))

# Merge municipality ID into municipality voting data 
VotingData_Dataverse <- VotingData_Dataverse |>
  left_join(crosswalk, by = "comuna")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

```


```{r}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Sanity check: Verify that ID_2002 codes from the shapefile 
# match the codes in the 1992 census
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Step 1: Randomly sample 10 comuna codes from the shapefile
sample_ids <- Comunas_Dataverse |> st_drop_geometry() |> 
  slice_sample(n = 10) |> pull(ID_2002)

# Step 2: Look up those 10 codes in the shapefile
# Shows what names the shapefile assigns them
Comunas_Dataverse |> st_drop_geometry() |> 
  filter(ID_2002 %in% sample_ids) |> select(ID_2002, NOMBRE)

# Step 3: Look up those same 10 codes in the census
# If names match, the coding systems are the same
Comunas_Censo_1992 |> filter(Codigo %in% sample_ids) |> select(Codigo, Nombre)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Creating variables for analysis
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Years of schooling

Chilenos_Censo_1987 <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  mutate(years_schooling = case_when(
    Tipo_educacion %in% 0:1  ~ 0,          # Never attended or kinder
    Tipo_educacion == 2      ~ Curso,      # Middle/elementary school
    Tipo_educacion %in% 3:11 ~ 8 + Curso,  # All high school types
    Tipo_educacion %in% 12:14 ~ 12 + Curso # College and related
  ))

# Separating years of schooling into categories

Chilenos_Censo_1987 <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  mutate(rango = case_when(
    years_schooling >= 13              ~ "high",
    years_schooling >= 9 & years_schooling <= 12 ~ "mid",
    years_schooling <= 8               ~ "low"
  ))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Separating bureaucrats
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Chilenos_Censo_1987 <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  mutate(burocrata = 
    Rama_actividad %in% c(
      750, 751, 752, 753,  # Public administration and defense
      800, 801, 802, 803,  # Education
      809                  # Adult education and other types
    ) |
    Ocupacion %in% c(
      # Military & police
      110,   # Armed forces, Police, Investigations
      5162,  # Police
      5163,  # Prison guards

      # Executive, legislative, public admin
      1100,  # Members of executive/legislative and public administration
      1110,  # Members of executive and legislative powers
      1120,  # Senior public administration officials
      1130,  # Heads of small communities

      # Legal system
      2421,  # Lawyers
      2422,  # Judges
      2429,  # Legal professionals (except lawyers and judges)
      3432,  # Legal technical assistants
      3439,  # Diplomats/consular officials

      # Education
      2310,  # University/higher education professors
      2320,  # Secondary school teachers
      2330,  # Primary and preschool teachers
      2331,  # Primary school teachers
      2332,  # Preschool teachers
      2340,  # Special education teachers
      2350,  # Other education professionals
      2351,  # Pedagogical methods specialists
      2352,  # General education inspectors
      3310,  # Higher ed teaching assistants and secondary para-teachers
      3311,  # Higher education teaching assistants
      3312,  # Secondary teaching assistants
      3320,  # Primary and preschool teaching assistants
      3321,  # Primary teaching assistants
      3322,  # Preschool teaching assistants
      3330,  # Special education teaching assistants
      3340,  # Technical instructors outside regular education

      # Healthcare
      2221,  # Physicians and surgeons
      2225,  # University nutritionists
      2226,  # University medical technologists
      2227,  # University physiotherapists/kinesiologists
      2231,  # Professional nurses
      2232,  # Professional midwives
      3221,  # Medical practitioners
      3229,  # Speech therapy technicians
      3231,  # Nursing auxiliaries/paramedics
      3232,  # Non-university auxiliary midwives

      # State bureaucrats & inspectors
      3440,  # Public customs and tax administration agents
      3441,  # Customs agents and border inspectors
      3442,  # State treasury officials
      3443,  # State social assistance and pension officials
      3444,  # State licensing and permits officials
      3449,  # State commercial establishment inspectors
      3450,  # Police inspectors and detectives

      # Social workers
      2446,  # Professional social workers
      3460   # Technical social workers and assistants
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MUNICIPALITY LEVEL VARIABLES  
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Proportion of bureaucrats per municipality, proportion of bureaucrats 
# per rank per municipality, and population per municipality 
prop_burocrata <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  group_by(Comuna_1987_Origen3) %>%
  summarise(prop_burocrata = as.numeric(mean(burocrata, na.rm = TRUE)),
    prop_high = as.numeric(mean(burocrata & rango == "high", na.rm = TRUE)),
    prop_mid  = as.numeric(mean(burocrata & rango == "mid",  na.rm = TRUE)),
    prop_low  = as.numeric(mean(burocrata & rango == "low",  na.rm = TRUE)),
    pop_1987  = n()
  )

# Joining the municipality level variables to the voting data databases 
VotingData_Dataverse <- VotingData_Dataverse %>%
  mutate(ID_2002_num = as.numeric(ID_2002)) %>%
  left_join(prop_burocrata, by = c("ID_2002_num" = "Comuna_1987_Origen3")) %>%
  select(-ID_2002_num) %>%
# Rescaling variables for interpretation 
  mutate(
    sh_victims_total = (shvictimas_until74_70 + shvictimas_75_plus_70),
        prop_burocrata = prop_burocrata * 100,
        prop_high      = prop_high * 100,
        prop_mid       = prop_mid  * 100,
        prop_low       = prop_low  * 100,
# Creating share of ranks among bureaucrats per municipality 
        sh_rural_70 = sh_rural_70 * 100) %>%
    mutate(share_high_among_buro = (prop_high / prop_burocrata) *100,
    share_mid_among_buro  = (prop_mid  / prop_burocrata) *100)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

# Analyses 

```{r}

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REGRESSIONS 
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------


# Running the regressions 
first_nocontrols <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = VoteShareNo ~ prop_burocrata + factor(IDProv), se_type = "CR2",
clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

first <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = VoteShareNo ~ prop_burocrata + sh_victims_total +
  lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + sh_rural_70 + factor(IDProv), 
  se_type = "CR2", clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRAPHS 
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Controls, labels, order
controls <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70", 
"sh_victims_total", "sh_rural_70")

term_labels <- c(
  "prop_burocrata"        = "Bureaucrats per municipality",
  "sh_victims_total"      = "Total victims / Pop. 1970",
  "share_allende70"       = "Allende vote share 1970",
  "lnDistRegCapital"      = "Ln distance to regional capital",
  "pop_1987"              = "Population 1987",
  "sh_rural_70" = "Share rural population"
)

term_order_1 <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "sh_rural_70", "share_allende70", 
                  "sh_victims_total", "prop_burocrata")

# Plot 1: prop_burocrata with all controls
bind_rows(
  tidy_model(first_nocontrols, "No Controls",   "prop_burocrata"),
  tidy_model(first,            "With Controls", c("prop_burocrata", 
  controls))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = factor(term, levels = term_order_1), 
  color = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                 height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels) +
  labs(title = "Model 1: Bureaucrat Share vs Vote Share No",
       x = "Estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODEL 
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Model summary
modelsummary(
  list("(1)" = first_nocontrols, 
       "(2)" = first),
  coef_map = c(
    "prop_burocrata" = "Prop. Bureaucrats"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "std.errors"),
  fmt = 4,
  output = "table_first.png"
)


```

```{r}

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# SENSITIVITY ANALYSIS 
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

sens_model_first <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ prop_burocrata + sh_rural_70 +
  sh_victims_total + lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + 
                   factor(IDProv),
                 data = VotingData_Dataverse,
                 weights = pop_1987)

sens_first <- sensemakr(model = sens_model_first,
                  treatment = "prop_burocrata",
                  kd = 1:3,
                  ky = 1:3)

plot(sens_first)
summary(sens_first)


sens_model_second <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ share_high_among_buro + share_mid_among_buro + 
  sh_victims_total + lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + 
                   factor(IDProv),
                 data = VotingData_Dataverse,
                 weights = pop_1987)

sens_second <- sensemakr(model = sens_model_second,
                  treatment = "share_high_among_buro",
                  kd = 1:3,
                  ky = 1:3)

plot(sens_second)
summary(sens_second)


sens_model_third <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ share_high_among_buro + share_mid_among_buro + 
  sh_victims_total + lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + 
                   factor(IDProv),
                 data = VotingData_Dataverse,
                 weights = pop_1987)

sens_third <- sensemakr(model = sens_model_third,
                  treatment = "share_mid_among_buro",
                  kd = 1:3,
                  ky = 1:3)

plot(sens_third)
summary(sens_third)
extract_sens <- function(s, label) {
  ss <- s$sensitivity_stats
  tibble(
    Model            = label,
    Estimate         = round(ss$estimate, 4),
    SE               = round(ss$se, 4),
    `Partial R² (D)` = round(ss$r2yd.x, 4),
    `RV (sig.)`      = round(ss$rv_qa, 4),
    `RV (zero)`      = round(ss$rv_q, 4)
  )
}

bind_rows(
  extract_sens(sens_second, "High-Education Bureaucrats"),
  extract_sens(sens_third,  "Mid-Education Bureaucrats")
) |>
  kbl(
    align    = c("l", rep("c", 5)),
    booktabs = TRUE,
    linesep  = ""
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    full_width        = FALSE,
    font_size         = 12,
    bootstrap_options = "none",
    html_font         = "Times New Roman"
  ) |>
  column_spec(1, width = "5cm", italic = FALSE, bold = FALSE) |>
  column_spec(2:6, width = "2.2cm") |>
  row_spec(0, bold = FALSE, italic = FALSE) |>
  save_kable("sensitivity_table.png", zoom = 3)
```

## Robustness 

1. Sensitivity tests 

```{r}

## USING MILITARY PRESENCE INSTEAD OF VICTIMS 

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REGRESSIONS
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

second_nocontrols_mil <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = VoteShareNo ~ share_high_among_buro + share_mid_among_buro + 
  factor(IDProv), 
clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

second_mil <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = VoteShareNo ~ share_high_among_buro + share_mid_among_buro + 
  DMilitaryPresence + lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + 
  factor(IDProv), 
  clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRAPHS
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

controls <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70",
"DMilitaryPresence")

term_labels <- c(
  "share_high_among_buro" = "High rank",
  "share_mid_among_buro"  = "Mid rank",
  "pop_1987"              = "Population 1987",
  "lnDistRegCapital"      = "Ln distance to reg. cap.",
  "share_allende70"       = "Allende vote share 1970",
  "DMilitaryPresence" = "Military Presence"
)

term_order <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70", 
                "DMilitaryPresence", "share_mid_among_buro", 
                "share_high_among_buro")

bind_rows(
  tidy_model(second_nocontrols_mil, "No Controls",   
  c("share_high_among_buro", "share_mid_among_buro")),
  tidy_model(second_mil,            "With Controls", 
  c("share_high_among_buro", "share_mid_among_buro", controls))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = factor(term, levels = term_order), 
  color = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                 height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels) +
  labs(title = "Bureaucrat Rank Composition vs Vote Share No",
       x = "Estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODEL
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

modelsummary(
  list("(1) No Controls" = second_nocontrols, 
       "(2) With Controls" = second),
  coef_map = c(
    "share_high_among_buro" = "High rank",
    "share_mid_among_buro"  = "Mid rank"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "std.errors"),
  output = "table.png"
)
```

```{r}

# Getting a sense of the data graphically 

# Distribution of years of schooling
ggplot(Chilenos_Censo_1987, aes(x = years_schooling)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 20, by = 2)) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Years of Schooling",
    subtitle = "Chileans, 1987",
    x = "Years of Schooling",
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Distribution of prop_burocrata across comunas
ggplot(prop_burocrata, aes(x = prop_burocrata)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  labs(title = "Distribution of Bureaucrat Share Across Comunas",
       x = "Proportion of Bureaucrats", y = "Count") +
  theme_minimal()

# Distribution of prop_high/mid/low across comunas
prop_rango_long <- prop_rango %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(prop_high, prop_mid, prop_low),
               names_to = "rango", values_to = "proportion") %>%
  mutate(rango = factor(recode(rango,
                        prop_high = "High (13+ years)",
                        prop_mid  = "Mid (9-12 years)",
```

Education and voting is a quadratic relationship 

```{r}
comuna_schooling <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  group_by(Comuna_1987_Origen3) %>%
  summarise(mean_years = mean(years_schooling, na.rm = TRUE))

df_plot <- VotingData_Dataverse %>%
  mutate(ID_2002_num = as.numeric(ID_2002)) %>%
  left_join(comuna_schooling, by = c("ID_2002_num" = "Comuna_1987_Origen3")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(VoteShareNo), !is.na(mean_years))

quad_model <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ mean_years + I(mean_years^2), data = df_plot)
coefs <- coef(quad_model)
turning_point <- -coefs["mean_years"] / (2 * coefs["I(mean_years^2)"])

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = mean_years, y = VoteShareNo)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.5, color = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2),
              color = "red", se = TRUE) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = turning_point, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  annotate("text", x = turning_point + 0.15,
           y = max(df_plot$VoteShareNo, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.95,
           label = paste0("Peak: ", round(turning_point, 2), " years"),
           hjust = 0, size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Education vs Vote Share No — Quadratic Fit",
       x = "Mean Years of Schooling",
       y = "Vote Share No") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"))




```

```{r}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REGRESSIONS

first_nocontrols <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = share_aylwin89 ~ prop_burocrata + factor(IDProv), se_type = "CR2",
clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

first <- lm_robust(data = VotingData_Dataverse, 
formula = share_aylwin89 ~ prop_burocrata + sh_victims_total +
  lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 + sh_rural_70 + factor(IDProv), 
  se_type = "CR2", clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRAPHS 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

controls <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70", 
"sh_victims_total", "sh_rural_70")

term_labels <- c(
  "prop_burocrata"        = "Bureaucrats per municipality",
  "sh_victims_total"      = "Total victims / Pop. 1970",
  "share_allende70"       = "Allende vote share 1970",
  "lnDistRegCapital"      = "Ln distance to regional capital",
  "pop_1987"              = "Population 1987",
  "sh_rural_70"           = "Share rural population"
)

                  "sh_victims_total", "prop_burocrata")

bind_rows(
  tidy_model(first_nocontrols, "No Controls",   "prop_burocrata"),
  tidy_model(first,            "With Controls", c("prop_burocrata", controls))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = factor(term, levels = term_order_1), 
  color = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +

# MODEL

  list("(1)" = first_nocontrols, 
       "(2)" = first),

)
```

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(marginaleffects)
library(modelsummary)

# ---- 1. Prep: center variables for interpretable main effects ----
df_plot <- df_plot %>%
  mutate(
    mean_years_c   = mean_years   - mean(mean_years,   na.rm = TRUE),
    sh_rural_70_c  = sh_rural_70  - mean(sh_rural_70,  na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---- 2. Fit nested models ----
m_linear <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ mean_years_c + sh_rural_70_c,
               data = df_plot)

m_quad <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ mean_years_c + I(mean_years_c^2) + sh_rural_70_c,
             data = df_plot)

m_interact <- lm(VoteShareNo ~ (mean_years_c + I(mean_years_c^2)) * sh_rural_70_c,
                 data = df_plot)

# ---- 3. Compare models ----
anova(m_linear, m_quad, m_interact)

modelsummary(
  list("Linear" = m_linear, "Quadratic" = m_quad, "Quad × Rural" = m_interact),
  stars = TRUE,
  gof_omit = "AIC|BIC|Log.Lik|F"
)

# ---- 4. Inspect the interaction model ----
summary(m_interact)
tidy(m_interact, conf.int = TRUE)

# Joint test: does rurality moderate the curve at all?
car::linearHypothesis(
  m_interact,
  c("mean_years_c:sh_rural_70_c = 0",
    "I(mean_years_c^2):sh_rural_70_c = 0")
)

# ---- 5. Marginal effects of mean_years at different rurality levels ----
# Slope of mean_years across its range, at low/mean/high rurality
slopes_by_rural <- slopes(
  m_interact,
  variables = "mean_years_c",
  newdata = datagrid(
    mean_years_c  = seq(min(df_plot$mean_years_c, na.rm = TRUE),
                        max(df_plot$mean_years_c, na.rm = TRUE),
                        length.out = 50),
    sh_rural_70_c = quantile(df_plot$sh_rural_70_c,
                             probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
)

# ---- 6. Predicted values for plotting ----
preds <- predictions(
  m_interact,
  newdata = datagrid(
    mean_years_c  = seq(min(df_plot$mean_years_c, na.rm = TRUE),
                        max(df_plot$mean_years_c, na.rm = TRUE),
                        length.out = 100),
    sh_rural_70_c = quantile(df_plot$sh_rural_70_c,
                             probs = c(0.1, 0.5, 0.9), na.rm = TRUE)
  )
) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    rural_level = factor(
      round(sh_rural_70_c, 3),
      labels = c("Low rural (10th pct)",
                 "Median rural (50th pct)",
                 "High rural (90th pct)")
    ),
    # back to original scale for readability
    mean_years = mean_years_c + mean(df_plot$mean_years, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

# ---- 7. Plot: predicted curves + raw data ----
ggplot() +
  geom_point(
    data = df_plot,
    aes(x = mean_years, y = VoteShareNo),
    alpha = 0.25, size = 1.5, color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = preds,
    aes(x = mean_years, ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high,
        fill = rural_level),
    alpha = 0.18
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = preds,
    aes(x = mean_years, y = estimate, color = rural_level),
    linewidth = 1.1
  ) +
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  labs(
    x = "Mean years (commune)",
    y = "Vote share No",
    color = "Rurality (1970)",
    fill  = "Rurality (1970)",
    title = "Quadratic effect of mean years on No vote, by rurality",
    subtitle = "Predicted values from interaction model with 95% CIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title.position = "plot")

# ---- 8. Diagnostics ----
par(mfrow = c(2, 2)); plot(m_interact); par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# Multicollinearity check (expect high VIFs on polynomial terms — that's normal)
car::vif(m_interact, type = "predictor")
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# Calculate key stats for annotations
n_total <- sum(!is.na(df_plot$sh_rural_70))
n_fully_urban <- sum(df_plot$sh_rural_70 == 0, na.rm = TRUE)
pct_fully_urban <- n_fully_urban / n_total
median_rural <- median(df_plot$sh_rural_70, na.rm = TRUE)

ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = sh_rural_70)) +
  # Histogram in proportions (not density)
  geom_histogram(aes(y = after_stat(count) / sum(after_stat(count))),
                 bins = 25, fill = "#4A90C2", color = "white", alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Shaded zones for substantive categories

           fill = "#E63946", alpha = 0.06) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = 60, xmax = 102, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf,
           fill = "#2A9D8F", alpha = 0.06) +
  
  # Median line
  geom_vline(xintercept = median_rural, linetype = "dashed", 
             color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.6) +
  
  # Zone labels at top
  annotate("text", x = 12, y = 0.085, label = "URBAN", 
           color = "#E63946", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 42, y = 0.085, label = "MIXED", 
           color = "grey40", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
  annotate("text", x = 80, y = 0.085, label = "RURAL", 
           color = "#2A9D8F", fontface = "bold", size = 3.8) +
  
  # Callout for the urban spike
  annotate("curve", x = 15, y = 0.07, xend = 2, yend = pct_fully_urban + 0.003,
           arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")), 
           color = "grey30", curvature = 0.3) +
  annotate("text", x = 22, y = 0.072,

           hjust = 0, size = 3.3, color = "grey20") +
  
  # Median callout
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Build rurality tertiles — assuming you have a 1970 rurality variable
# Adjust the variable name (e.g. sh_rural_70) to match your data
df_facet <- df_plot %>%
  filter(!is.na(sh_rural_70)) %>%
  mutate(rurality_tertile = ntile(sh_rural_70, 3),
         rurality_tertile = factor(rurality_tertile,
                                   levels = 1:3,
                                   labels = c("Urban",
                                              "Mixed",
                                              "Rural")))

# Tertile colors matching your original plot
tertile_colors <- c("Urban"  = "#E74C3C",
                    "Mixed" = "#3498DB",
                    "Rural" = "#27AE60")

ggplot(df_facet, aes(x = mean_years, y = VoteShareNo)) +
  # Points: only the panel's own tertile, colored
  geom_point(aes(color = rurality_tertile), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
  # Quadratic fit: restricted to the panel's tertile
  geom_smooth(aes(color = rurality_tertile, fill = rurality_tertile),
              method = "lm", formula = y ~ x + I(x^2),
              se = TRUE, alpha = 0.2) +
facet_wrap(~ rurality_tertile, nrow = 1, scales = "free_x") +
  scale_color_manual(values = tertile_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = tertile_colors) +
  labs(title = "Education and No vote, by rurality tertile",
       subtitle = "Quadratic fits with 95% CIs",
       x = "Mean years of education (municipality)",
       y = "Vote share No") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "none",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"))
```

```{r}
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# POPULATION-LEVEL EDUCATION AS COVARIATE
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Education proportions for the whole population (not just bureaucrats)
prop_rango_pop <- Chilenos_Censo_1987 %>%
  group_by(Comuna_1987_Origen3) %>%
  summarise(
    prop_high_pop = as.numeric(mean(rango == "high", na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    prop_mid_pop  = as.numeric(mean(rango == "mid",  na.rm = TRUE)) * 100,
    prop_low_pop  = as.numeric(mean(rango == "low",  na.rm = TRUE)) * 100
  )

# Join into voting data
VotingData_Dataverse <- VotingData_Dataverse %>%
  mutate(ID_2002_num = as.numeric(ID_2002)) %>%
  left_join(prop_rango_pop, by = c("ID_2002_num" = "Comuna_1987_Origen3")) %>%
  select(-ID_2002_num)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# REGRESSIONS — adding prop_high_pop and prop_mid_pop as covariates
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Model 1: prop_burocrata + population education
first_edu <- lm_robust(
  data = VotingData_Dataverse,
  formula = VoteShareNo ~ prop_burocrata + prop_high_pop + prop_mid_pop +
    sh_victims_total + lnDistRegCapital + share_allende70 + pop_1987 +
    sh_rural_70 + factor(IDProv),
  se_type = "CR2", clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987
)

# Model 2: rank composition + population education
second_edu <- lm_robust(
  data = VotingData_Dataverse,
  formula = VoteShareNo ~ share_high_among_buro + share_mid_among_buro +
    prop_high_pop + prop_mid_pop + sh_victims_total + lnDistRegCapital +
    share_allende70 + pop_1987 + factor(IDProv),
  se_type = "CR2", clusters = IDProv, weights = pop_1987
)

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# GRAPHS
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Plot 1: Model 1 with vs. without population education
controls_1 <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70",
                "sh_victims_total", "sh_rural_70")

term_labels_1 <- c(
  "prop_burocrata"   = "Bureaucrats per municipality",
  "prop_high_pop"    = "High-education population share",
  "prop_mid_pop"     = "Mid-education population share",
  "sh_victims_total" = "Total victims / Pop. 1970",
  "share_allende70"  = "Allende vote share 1970",
  "lnDistRegCapital" = "Ln distance to regional capital",
  "pop_1987"         = "Population 1987",
  "sh_rural_70"      = "Share rural population"
)

term_order_1 <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "sh_rural_70", "share_allende70",
                  "sh_victims_total", "prop_mid_pop", "prop_high_pop",
                  "prop_burocrata")

bind_rows(
  tidy_model(first,     "Original",            c("prop_burocrata", controls_1)),
  tidy_model(first_edu, "With Pop. Education", c("prop_burocrata", "prop_high_pop",
                                                  "prop_mid_pop", controls_1))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = factor(term, levels = term_order_1),
             color = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                 height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels_1) +
  labs(title = "Model 1: Bureaucrat Share vs Vote Share No (with pop. education)",
       x = "Estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

# Plot 2: Model 2 with vs. without population education
controls_2 <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70", "sh_victims_total")

term_labels_2 <- c(
  "share_high_among_buro" = "High rank",
  "share_mid_among_buro"  = "Mid rank",
  "prop_high_pop"         = "High-education population share",
  "prop_mid_pop"          = "Mid-education population share",
  "pop_1987"              = "Population 1987",
  "lnDistRegCapital"      = "Ln distance to reg. cap.",
  "share_allende70"       = "Allende vote share 1970",
  "sh_victims_total"      = "Total victims / Pop. 1970"
)

term_order_2 <- c("pop_1987", "lnDistRegCapital", "share_allende70",
                  "sh_victims_total", "prop_mid_pop", "prop_high_pop",
                  "share_mid_among_buro", "share_high_among_buro")

bind_rows(
  tidy_model(second,     "Original",            c("share_high_among_buro",
                                                  "share_mid_among_buro",
                                                  controls_2)),
  tidy_model(second_edu, "With Pop. Education", c("share_high_among_buro",
                                                  "share_mid_among_buro",
                                                  "prop_high_pop", "prop_mid_pop",
                                                  controls_2))
) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = factor(term, levels = term_order_2),
             color = model)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = ci_low, xmax = ci_high),
                 height = 0.2, position = position_dodge(width = 0.5)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = term_labels_2) +
  labs(title = "Model 2: Bureaucrat Rank Composition vs Vote Share No (with pop. education)",
       x = "Estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL, color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# MODEL TABLE
## -----------------------------------------------------------------------------

modelsummary(
  list("(1) Model 1"          = first,
       "(2) Model 1 + Pop Ed" = first_edu,
       "(3) Model 2"          = second,
       "(4) Model 2 + Pop Ed" = second_edu),
  coef_map = c(
    "prop_burocrata"        = "Proportion of bureaucrats",
    "share_high_among_buro" = "High rank share",
    "share_mid_among_buro"  = "Mid rank share",
    "prop_high_pop"         = "High-education pop. share",
    "prop_mid_pop"          = "Mid-education pop. share"
  ),
  gof_map = c("nobs", "r.squared", "std.errors"),
  fmt = 4,
  output = "table_with_pop_education.png"
)
```


```{r}
tidy_model <- function(model, model_name, keep_terms) {
  as.data.frame(summary(model)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("term") %>%
    rename(estimate = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`, ci_low = `CI Lower`, 
    ci_high = `CI Upper`) %>%
    filter(term %in% keep_terms) %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
}
```
